description: Named-type payload validation through a generated crate: gen schema generates a committed self-contained schema whose property record binds its value under from-type-name, twice into scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled processor, naming every kdlith type it spells through the generated crate alone, collects a committed data document as a reading linked under complete scope through its generated reader: each payload streams as a pending item with its raw value, the one decoding as the U64 its definition names passes, the string where a definition names Bool fails KDLITH-REF005, and the payload whose definition names a type no declaration answers fails KDLITH-REF005 with the same code; linked under local scope the same diagnostics are reported and the reading does not fail, each as vet data reports it on the same input
